additional_info.subject: RE: ID0393083-DC/Si-D/TR-[Y2 / R6 313065117092] Outlets are out of order CRM:00641000814
additional_info.body:
Hi Yunus,
I hope this email finds you well.
Regarding your query, we have analyzed the logs and found that while rebooting, the charging converter grouping is not occurring after 12/15, which means that either the converters are faulty or the converter grouping wiring connections are loose. We need to schedule a site intervention to check the component feasibility and inspect the wiring connections. The MLFB for the power converter is 8EM5903-0AA01-0AA2.
We also need to check the wiring terminals of the power converter on pins 7 & 8 and 11 & 12. Additionally, we need to check the switching matrix connections, which are on pages 49, 51, 52, and 53 in the circuit diagram of the charger. Check the connections in KF4 module of the main PLC. Check if the power supply and CAN cables to the power converter are connected properly.
I am writing to formally inform that we are moving case 0393083 ﻿from the

additional_info.subject: ID0393083-DC/Si-D/TR-[Y2 / R6 313065117092] Outlets are out of order CRM:00641000814
additional_info.body:
Hello Emre-abi, good afternoon.
After my investigation yesterday, we concluded that something was wrong with the Converter, during converter grouping it couldn't reach the 100V and when it lowered the voltage, the PowerOn = True was stuck and then it wasn't possible to continue the converter grouping.
After replacing the converter it's working again.
I will proceed to close the ticket, provide me the service report.
Thank you!
Best regards,
Francisco
